lines.text: God measured the waters in the hollow of His hand and needed no counselor to teach Him.
The nations are like a drop in a bucket, and Lebanon's trees and animals could not fuel an offering enough.
One who cannot afford a gold idol chooses stone that will not rot and seeks a skilled craftsman.
God sits above the circle of the earth, and its dwellers are like giants.
The LORD will not grow tired, and those who wait upon Him will mount up with wings like eagles.
